comparison.objective: Separate two linked S-hooks and hang each on a separate support without putting either down; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual in-hand reorientation, unhooking, and hanging differ from counterholding, hex-key engagement, fine rotation, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Hooks must be separated and independently supported without an intermediate set-down; candidate requires quantified dynamic performance and lock retention.
comparison.reason: No meaningful objective or success-condition overlap exists.
